title: Wolf Horn - Control All Wolves - Stay Or Follow
description: Control your entire pack of wolves with a single item. Use the horn to tell the entire pack (up to 32) to Stay or Follow. Also custom wolves and magical items, weapons, armour, off-hand. And a custom structure for easy access with bonus content.
body:
# MxSxC1 - The Wolf Pack 

## **Pack Purpose**

**Use the Wolf Horn to alternate your pack between Sit and Follow mode. Control up to 32 wolves.**

**NOTE: /function #mxwolf:load This MUST be run for the pack to work. This will also give you the manual.**


This pack introduces various features to let you control entire wolf packs including getting an entire pack (up to 32 wolves) to Sit/Stay at the same time.
It also includes weapons, items, structures and bonus items.

Video: [https://youtu.be/lzmlgzLdZ8Q](https://youtu.be/lzmlgzLdZ8Q)

**The Ghost Wolf Horn - Main-Hand Horn**
-     Set all players wolves to Stand/Sit at the same time with the Ghost Wolf Horn.
-     Control up to 32 wolves simultaneously.
-     Bonus Run Speed
-     Bonus Luck
-     Bonus Interaction Range

**The Wolf Shard - Off-Hand Wolf Shard**
-   Bonus Armour
-   Bonus Attack Speed

**The Howling Blade - Main-Hand Sword**
-   Enchants: Sharpness, Smite, Looting, Sweeping Edge
-   Bonus Armour
-   Bonus Attack Speed

- **Manual - Trigger From Book
- Run most functions directly from clickable pages within the manual

**Bonuses**
- Elements From Lucky Fishing Pack (does not include dragonflies, though if you have the Lucky Fishing Pack installed will work).

## Functions (These can be run directly from clickable pages in the manual).

/function #mxwolf:load This MUST be run for the pack to work. This will also give you the manual.
/function mxwolf:man Give players the manual with clickable links
/function mxwolf:giveall Give all Wolf Pack Items
/function mxwolf:givehowlblade GIve Howling Blade
/function mxwolf:givewolfhorn Give Wolf Pack Horn (Pack Control)
/function mxwolf:givewolfshard Give Wolf Shard (Off-Hand)
/function mxwolf:killwolfpack Kill the wolf pack
/function mxwolf:mistxiii Summon Mist XIII (Pack Leader)
/function mxwolf:summonpack Summon Wolf Pack
/function mxwolf:wolfhut Summon Wolf Hut(WARNING: destroys existing blocks)

## Notes / Issues / TODO / Work In progress / Future Versions

Abstraction to control any pet type (or mob for that matter) is being worked on.

This hasn't been fully tested on multiplayer and where 2 players are using the horn it may be glitchy or control the other players wolves. A fix is in the works for this.

Levelling up not yet implemented.

Alpha wolf (Mist XIII) is not controlled separately (yet)

Alpha wolf (Mist XIII) buffs. Not yet implemented.

Stealth mode. Not yet implemented

Setting teams not yet implemented.

Allowing for multiple teams and PVP/Co-Op not yet implemented.

Kennels not yet implemented.

Allowing for one player to control multiple wolf packs not yet impacted.

Guard mode not yet implemented.

Low health rescue not yet implemented.

Patrol mode. Not yet implemented.

Wolf Armour. Not yet implemented.

Arena Mode will come under the Arena pack and this pack combined.

**WHAT THIS IS NOT:**

This pack DOES NOT include custom wolf models, armour, collars, glowing effects, or any textures. That will be a separate pack.
This pack DOES NOT include abstraction of pets, this covers only wolves.

**Steps To Install & Update**
Drop the pack into the following folder:

C:\Users\[UserName]\AppData\Roaming\.minecraft\saves\[GameSaveName]\datapacks\mxwolfpack
Note that our videos and screenshots use around 25 packs, some unreleased, this pack does what it says, but does not include some of the other effects, textures, music, shaders, etc...you may see.

[https://github.com/MxSxC1/MxSxC1WolfPack](https://github.com/MxSxC1/MxSxC1WolfPack)
